entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The mural should display on the front[n]wall now, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd expect so. Joker, if you please.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We just have to solve this puzzle.[n]You can do it, Joker!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is the device that opens the door,[n]right? The light's reflecting in the right[n]direction now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sure the door will open now.[n]Let's go confirm it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yes! We finished it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A child pulling on her mother's clothes?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More voices...

entries.speaker: Girl's Voice
entries.en: I'm... I'm tired of eating dinner alone[n]all the time.

entries.speaker: Girl's Voice
entries.en: It's always just convenience store[n]bentos...

entries.speaker: Girl's Voice
entries.en: I wanna go somewhere.[n]Take me on a trip!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The one clinging to her mother would be[n]Futaba-chan, right?

entries.speaker: Young Woman's Voice
entries.en: Don't be so selfish!

entries.speaker: Young Woman's Voice
entries.en: You know I'm working hard to support[n]you, right!?

entries.speaker: Young Woman's Voice
entries.en: Ugh!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She seemed pretty angry...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that the maternity neurosis the voice[n]from earlier mentioned?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought it was pretty normal for a child[n]to want to spend time with their parents,[n]though...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. Looks like Futaba was a pretty[n]lonely kid growin' up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So these incidents compounded, forcing[n]her mother to suicide?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: ...I must die.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: I killed her... That's why I'm here in this[n]tomb...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't say that!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: I will die...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why'd she get so quiet all of a sudden?[n]What happened to that snarky[n]personality?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Could her heart perhaps be growing[n]weaker?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We have to hurry and save her!
